snippet.title: Final Fantasy Sonic X - Episode 1
snippet.description:
Final Fantasy Sonic X, a fan series created by a user named BlackDevilX. A Sonic fan series that I have played in my childhood alongside Sonic RPG and many more! I've had a few people request me to do a playthrough of this game, so why not?

New beginnings, Sonic and company encounter a mysterious sword and a brand new adversary!

Wanna play this episode of FFSX?
Click here: http://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/197118
